facts.text: Gomez, darling, dinner is ready. Fester is home, and he looks very well for a man who was lost.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Morticia's real line is 'Don't torture yourself, Gomez. That's my job.'.
facts.fix: Don't torture yourself, Gomez. That's my job.

fix_note.text: Don't torture yourself, Gomez. That's my job.
